description: This file defines a template class QuicArenaScopedPtr, a smart pointer similar to std::unique_ptr, designed to handle objects that may originate from an arena allocator. It includes methods for construction, destruction, comparison, and management of the pointer, with special handling for arena-based memory.

classes.name: quic::QuicArenaScopedPtr
classes.description: A smart pointer class that manages objects which may be allocated from an arena, supporting both heap and arena memory sources.
